classification.difficultyReason: Identify n=20, r=7 and p=3/11, find the complementary probability and substitute directly into the binomial formula.

content.prompt: If the probability of a manufacturer’s machine breaking down is $\frac{3}{11}$, find the probability that at any particular time 7 machines out of a total of 20 machines will be broken down. Assume that the machines break down independently. Leave your answer in index form.

answer.worked:
Let $X$ be the number of broken-down machines. Then $X\sim\operatorname{Bin}(20,\frac{3}{11})$.
$$\begin{align*}P(X=7)&=\binom{20}{7}\left(\frac{3}{11}\right)^7\left(1-\frac{3}{11}\right)^{20-7}\\&=\binom{20}{7}\left(\frac{3}{11}\right)^7\left(\frac{8}{11}\right)^{13}\end{align*}$$
